name: ie-formation
description: Use this skill whenever asked about forming, incorporating, or registering a business in Ireland. Trigger on phrases like "Ireland company formation", "CRO registration", "LTD Ireland", "DAC Ireland", "sole trader Ireland", "Form A1 Ireland", "PPS number business", "incorporate Ireland", "CORE portal", "register business Ireland", "RBO Ireland", "TR1 Ireland", "TR2 Ireland", "Companies Act 2014", "CLG Ireland", "PLC Ireland", or any question about choosing or registering an Irish entity. Covers entity comparison (Sole Trader, Partnership, LP, LLP, LTD / CLS, DAC, CLG, PLC), CRO online portal (CORE) registration steps, Revenue TR1 / TR2 tax registration, sector-specific licensing (Central Bank, CCPC, DPC), RBO beneficial ownership filing, PPS number requirements for directors and shareholders, and tax treatment by entity type including the 12.5% trading CT rate and PRSI Class S.
